metadata.description: Agent Plugins by Mark B. Sigler: portable Agent Skills and MCP configuration.

plugins.name: aha-feature
plugins.description: Elicit, elaborate, and verify Aha! features as spec-driven records through the Aha! MCP server, with EARS requirements and on-demand Spec Kit, OpenSpec, or Kiro export.

plugins.name: code-modernization-plugin
plugins.description: Gartner-aligned Code Modernization playbooks (Refactor & Rearchitect) with elicitations, ADRs, and Strangler Fig gates, plus pluggable stack profiles starting with IBM Z mainframe (COBOL, PL/I, Assembler, JCL, CICS, IMS, Db2, VSAM), for Copilot and Cursor.

plugins.name: codebase-diagrams
plugins.description: Map a codebase's architecture as validated Mermaid diagrams (system overview, layers, dependencies, data flow, build pipelines) and render them to PNG.
